outputs.explanation: Panel A includes bar graphs quantifying band intensity (mean ± SD) across WT, Atxn1-KI, and Atxn1-KI;HMGB1 mice for nuclear, cytosolic, and mitochondrial fractions. These are averaged bar charts, but no individual data points (dots/circles) are overlaid on the bars despite N=4 being stated, so the underlying variability/spread cannot be assessed.
Panel B consists of immunoelectron micrographs, not a plot of averaged data, so the individual-data-points check does not apply.
Panel C is a western blot showing HMGB1 detection across purification methods with no accompanying quantification plot, so the check does not apply.
Panel D is a western blot from the proteinase K protection assay with no accompanying quantification plot, so the check does not apply.
